title: Executive Order 14243 — Eliminating Information Silos
summary: Policy foundation for broad federal data access and consolidation.

sources.title: Executive Order 14243 — Stopping Waste, Fraud, and Abuse by Eliminating Information Silos

data.name: Stopping Waste, Fraud, and Abuse by Eliminating Information Silos
data.text: Directs agencies, to the maximum extent consistent with law, to provide designated federal officials access to unclassified records, data, software systems and IT systems and to facilitate intra- and inter-agency sharing and consolidation.

inferences: The order creates policy conditions aligned with Palantir's data-integration capabilities.
caveats: Alignment is not evidence the order was written for Palantir or guarantees an award.
